content_note: Composable attack frames — display_name without affinity in title. Affinity slots optional. Surge frames expose delivery_modalities (concussive/piercing/slashing ω) like strikes; flat pierce still applies per-channel. cooldown_scaling derives cooldown_turns from base_power (anti-spam). See docs/ATTACK-CATALOG.md.

templates.description: Baseline ranged pressure pulse — special-offense saturation path with tunable fusion weights.

primary_affinity.help: Optional — pick one elemental ID for chart key + infusion palette, or null for non-elemental (neutral Layer 1 multiplier until vectors extend).

secondary_affinity.help: Optional fusion chip — omit when unused; must differ from primary when both set. If primary is null, secondary must be null.

affinity_weights_rule.when_secondary_null: When primary is set and secondary is null: affinity_weights vertex on primary (=1) unless the UI opens the simplex editor.
affinity_weights_rule.when_secondary_set: affinity_weights[secondary]=η, affinity_weights[primary]=1−η; optional advanced_simplex_tail distributes ε across other affinities in inspect-only UI.
affinity_weights_rule.when_primary_null: Player leaves primary null — omit chart-key affinity; affinity_weights empty or unset; resolver treats matchup multiplier as neutral baseline.
affinity_weights_rule.when_primary_set_secondary_null: Default vertex on primary unless UI exposes full simplex: affinity_weights[primary]=1.

cooldown_scaling.help: At resolve/equip time: cooldown_turns = round(min_turns + (max_turns-min_turns) * (base_power - base_power.min)/(base_power.max - base_power.min)); clamp to [min_turns, max_turns]. Weaker slider ⇒ shorter cooldown; maxed power ⇒ longest cooldown for this frame.

delivery_modalities.normalize_to_simplex_note: Renormalize ω to sum 1 — player shapes concussive vs piercing vs slashing coupling on special mitigation (same ψ kernels as strikes).
